title: porter port catalog
description: Community catalog of ports (ports/catalog.yaml): which mods have a public port profile, for which version pair, how far they got, and whether the result may be distributed. A profile is a port config + scenarios + generic rules; the ported output of an all-rights-reserved mod is never listed as distributable. Added by RFC 004 (additive).

status.description: planned: profile wanted; closure: closure measured; compiles: 0 javac errors; builds: the target build passes; scenarios: scenario diff tests pass; playable: tested in a real game.

scenarioPassRate.description: Passed scenario diff tests / scenario diff tests run, 0..1 (absent when none ran).

licence.description: SPDX id of the original mod's licence, or 'ARR' (all rights reserved).

distributable.description: Whether a ported jar may be published: only true for open-licence mods or with the author's written permission (permission must then be set).

permission.description: Link to the author's permission when distributable is true for a non-open licence.

profile.description: Repository path of the public profile (port.yaml, scenarios, generic rules).
